entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Elijah Arroyo
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed with reporters Monday that Arroyo will miss "significant time" due to a shoulder injury that he picked up during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) is slated for a "full week of work" and has a "good chance" to play Sunday night against the Chiefs, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Tuesday's practice report.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: Gould won't return to Sunday's game against the Titans after being diagnosed with a concussion, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Mayfield (thumb) was seen participating in Wednesday's practice and was throwing while wearing a glove on his right hand, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said that Douglas (ankle) will be a limited participant in Monday's informal practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Colbie Young
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Darnell Mooney
entries.summary: Mooney (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Saints, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love (ankle) is expected to do some running Tuesday, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Justin Joly
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: Turpin (ribs) is expected to miss the team's Week 7 matchup with the Eagles, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) was listed as a non-participant in Tuesday's walk-through.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey won't return to Sunday's game at Kansas City due to a concussion.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Matt Hibner
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said after Monday's 23-17 win over the Commanders that Evans' early exit was due to right Achilles tendinitis, but he doesn't believe the wideout will require further testing or imaging, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports. "I hope he recovers throughout the week, but you don't think it's a long-term thing, but right now it ended up costing him two quarters and hopefully he'll be able to play [Sunday in Atlanta]," Shanahan said.

entries.name: Quinshon Judkins
entries.summary: Browns head coach Todd Monken said that he's optimistic that Judkins (ankle) will be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Rashod Bateman
entries.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Bateman (shoulder) "should be OK" after exiting late in the second quarter of Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Browns, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Sean Tucker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: The Vikings downgraded Hockenson to out for Sunday's game against the Saints due to a concussion.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyler Badie
entries.summary: Badie (thumb) won't return to Thursday's game against Seattle, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports. He finished with one carry for six yards.

entries.name: Tyler Warren
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) won't have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 7, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Braxton Berrios
entries.summary: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: Runyon (lower body) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: The 49ers downgraded Kirk (calf) to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: David Sills
entries.summary: Sills (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Bills,  Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Sampson (knee) won't be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's contest against the Ravens, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: The Eagles have downgraded Stowers (quadriceps) to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

entries.name: Grant Calcaterra
entries.summary: The Eagles downgraded Calcaterra (back) to out Saturday for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Hurts
entries.summary: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (core) was seen jogging at practice Thursday, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: The Vikings designated Mason (thumb) for return from injured reserve Monday.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Bryant (ankle) was placed on the Broncos' injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Roman Wilson
entries.summary: Wilson (finger) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, isn't expected to be ready at that time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.
